notes.title: Gnoctober Update Out Now!
notes.notes:
Fellow Gnombers, as promised we present you the Gnoctober Update!

The Gnoctober update is releasing now and will also include a 50% sale for the next 10 days!
We hope you like the changes and additions we made to the game.

New Area, 3 New Bombs and New Enemies

Here you can see the Scaregnome fighting off a horde of new enemy types in the new Grove area using the new Pumpkin Bomb

https://i.imgur.com/T1B1gqO.png

In this picture, the Gnomberman laid down new Ice Bombs to slow enemies.

https://i.imgur.com/MDkDty9.png

We've also added the Fire Bomb, which has damage scaling according to bomb force, not pictured here, so you'll have to unlock it on your own to see what it's like!

Major Lag Fix
We have fixed the major lag spikes which degraded the gameplay. In our tests, moments that dropped down to 2-3 fps now run at 60 fps without a hitch. We haven't eliminated lag spikes completely, but you should no longer get game-breaking freezes and hangups due to spamming the Crystal Bomb and filling the screen with particles.

Bomb Force Rework
We decided to rework the way the knockback mechanic and how the bomb force stat works.
Bomb force now only increases bomb-specific characteristics and now only increases knockback by a little bit for a few bombs which benefit from it. For example, the flare will last longer with higher force, the grenade can be thrown further, the mist bomb will linger longer, the crystal bomb will spawn more clones etc.

Quality Of Life Improvements
Here's a list of highly requested QOL changes that we made to the game:

The knockback stat from bomb force will only affect bombs whose characteristic is knockback (for example, the balloon and the wave bombs). The knockback stat would often times throw enemies INTO the player, making the powerup actually a disadvantage for late game, so we have toned it down significantly for bombs which don't need it.
The magnet shroom will now apply to the ENTIRE map, instead of just a large area. Exp drops that are part of setpieces and structures won't be affected.
Added filler waves whenever you completely clear a wave so you never have to wait for the next wave to start spawning.
Added a proper ending to each stage where you don't need to die, you can just step into a portal now to finish it.
Added VSync option to settings.


Bugfixes

Added higher quality trails left by bigger explosions.
When notifications were shown about unlocks, the "close" button couldn't be selected.
Sometimes the background music would pause and unpause inconsistently when showing notifications or unlocks.
Fixed bugs where the inside of the dynamite explosion would spawn extra projectiles and do double heals.
Add 2 missing stats to stats menu: sledgehammer and magic star count
Nerfed Gnomnomnom health and exp gain amount
Mist bomb particles reduced, but increased their size. This improves fps drops when spamming it.

notes.title: Gnoctober Update on Halloween
notes.notes:
Fellow Gnome lovers,

We are excited to announce that we will be doing a content update on Halloween.
We have finished working on a demo for our upcoming game, Man Pit, so now we can switch back to Gnomber to deliver on our promises.

We will also do a big 50% sale on October 30th, so hold onto your little gnome hats lest the winds from Gaben's powerful embrace blow them away.

In the Gnoctober update, you can expect

 New fall-themed level
 New bombs and enemies!
 Physics engine optimization and rewrite, which fixes ALL the lag when you're going crazy with lots of bombs
 Various quality of life improvements


In the meantime, you can check out Man Pit, our challenging platformer game with procedurally generated levels: Man Pit on Steam

Play the demo, let us know what you think!

Cheers!

Niko, head Gnome at LisiSoft

notes.title: Patch v1.0.6 - Future plans and bugfixes
notes.notes:
Fellow gnome-lovers,

We see your complaints about the performance, so we are planning to do an optimization update soon! We're working on another game which will be available in August. After that, we can get to Gnomber and do a large rewrite of the physics system which will address all the FPS and lag issues. We will also do some balancing, quality-of-life changes and settings for graphics and input mapping. Expect a big update in September.

This patch is just a quick fix for some urgent problems:

Disabled vsync on all systems. We will add a vsync option to the game this week, but since lots of people have been getting FPS drops, this is a quick fix that can improve it for some.
Lowered limits to some level up perks like Ball Magic and Morning Star. They were too overpowered for both the game balance and your CPU when you had 16 of each, spawning hundreds of particles per second.
Fix Gnampire deaths from hunger not counting towards unlocks
Fix crash that sometimes happened when the Gnombie died and started respawning with an uncharged bomb in hand
Fix very rare potential crash when placing a bomb which was despawned by the game


As always, thank you for the feedback. We appreciate all of it as it helps us improve the game.

Happy gnombing!

notes.title: Patch v1.0.5 - Minor bugfixes
notes.notes:
Small update for today.

Here is what we added:

Pickups spawned outside of the level will automatically start homing towards the player. No more frustration over pickups being thrown outside of the level edges!
Fix some achievements not being set when quitting the game before dying


Happy gnombing!

notes.title: Patch v1.0.4 - Announcement and bugfixes
notes.notes:
Fellow Gnombers,

We are reading your feedback and working on improving the game. We heard your complaints about performance and frustrating gameplay elements so we fixed some of them and are actively working on fixing the rest in the coming patches!

Here is what we added in this patch:

Pickups like exp drops, bombs and shrooms no longer fall out of the bordered play area.
New game loop code, which should be less buggy on high refresh rate screens and on slow computers should increase performance by 1-2fps. It ain't much, but it's honest work.
Steam would sometimes not be recognized during launch and as a result, your achievements did not show up in the steam client. This has been fixed. Just boot into the game and all your achievements which you should have earned will show up at once.

We appreciate all your feedback, because it helps us improve the game, so keep them coming.

Happy gnombing!

notes.title: Patch v1.0.3 - Minor bugfixes
notes.notes:
We fixed two more goblin-related bugs in the game.


Goblins summoned by the Gnoblin character would cause more crashes from time to time (unrelated to previous crash which was fixed in v1.0.2)
Friendly goblins (they just keep coming back with more bugs!) no longer chase after seemingly invisible  enemies. They would sometimes go psycho and start running after an imaginary enemy.


Happy gnombing!

notes.title: Patch v1.0.2 - Bugfixes
notes.notes:
Dear gnombers,

As bugs come up, we slowly squish them. Here's some stuff we fixed in this patch:

 Unplugging the joystick would crash the game in menus
 Unplugging or changing the joystick/gamepad would incorrectly unpause the game
 Fixed a bug where summoning friendly goblins as the Gnoblin character would cause an instant crash


As always, thanks for the bug reports!

notes.title: Patch v1.0.1 - Bugfixes
notes.notes:
Dear gnombers,

In this patch we fixed the following problems:

 The bootup sound effect was too loud. Lowered the volume by a significant amount.
 Fixed a bug where having friendly Goblins sometimes crashed the game.
 Fixed a crash caused by the achievements module.


Thank you for your bug reports and reviews. We appreciate all input, it helps us know what to improve/change for the future. Keep them coming!

notes.title: Structures Update Out Now!
notes.notes:
Greetings gnomefolk!
We have a major update for the game.
Here's what we added.

Structures - Just follow the waypoints!
Discover unique structures/chests/shrooms scattered around the world.

https://i.imgur.com/29EpMeU.gif

Better Aiming
Directional bombs can now be aimed more accurately. They now also have an arrow to show you where you're aiming.

https://i.imgur.com/Bn4wQ6F.gif

Other changes:

 Mac OS release
 Added more walls to smack enemies against.
 Balanced the levels, they should now be easier for beginners.
 Buffed base player stats. Base crit chance is higher and the bomb charges faster (takes 3 seconds to charge instead of 4)
 Added vfx to consumable shrooms
 Fixed grenade unlock text
 Fixed damage blocked stat tracking
 Fixed various small bugs

notes.title: Structures Update Developer Stream
notes.notes:
Greetings gnomefolk!
Our programmer will be streaming the development of our new Structures Update, which will add loads of new structures, chests and traps to the various levels in the game. We'll be taking your feedback, suggestions and requests. Tune in to help guide the direction of the game!

Stream Link: Gnomber - Structures Update Developer Stream
